5 affirmations to tell
yourself every morning...

I can begin gently.
This morning does not need to be rushed.
Unclench your jaw and take one slow breath.

Peace is allowed here.
I do not have to force my pace to feel worthy.
Let your shoulders drop and feel the floor.

This moment can hold me.
Calm grows when I stop bracing for more.
Place a hand on your chest and exhale softly.

I choose an easy start.
My nervous system responds to kindness.
Relax your hands and breathe out a little longer.

I am safe enough now.
Stillness can meet me before the day begins.
Sit tall, soften your face, and notice the breath.
